$comment: Stage 21e — fork-friendly architecture. Upstream Duo's defaults. To fork, copy this file to fork.config.json (gitignored) and edit. See docs/HOW-TO-FORK.md for the layered fork modes that read from this file.

bootstrap.$comment: Defaults for ~/.claude/duo/external-domains.json (host patterns matched against the hostname of any URL the agent tries to navigate to; matches route via shell.openExternal instead of the embedded browser) and ~/.claude/duo/pins.json (which help-bundle files first-launch pins). v0.4.3 ENH-009 expanded the externalDomains list to cover Slack, Gmail + Google Workspace, Atlassian, Microsoft 365 alongside the existing *.capitalone.com Cap One AIP default.
